fixes.why: spanish-empire.json keyframe spanish-empire_1878 correction: 'Cuba, Puerto Rico, the whole Philippines (Sulu a vassal after July 1878), Guam, the Northern Marianas, the Carolines and Palau, plus the African posts Fernando Po, Annobon and Ifni' (1878-1898; spanish-empire_1873 and _1877 likewise); its ledger/121-125 cede them in 1898-12/1899-02 and dissolve into kingdom-of-spain. captaincy-general-of-cuba and spanish-east-indies (type colony) record no vassal relation to kingdom-of-spain. fixes.what: The protectorates over Spanish Morocco (from 1912) and Spanish Sahara (from 1884) are kept as this dossier's vassals until 1956 and 1975, although /ledger/62 hands all the kingdom's land to second-spanish-republic on 14 April 1931 and the dossier holds nothing until /ledger/65 (November 1975).
fixes.why: Ledger/62 note: 'The Republic, the Civil War (1936-1939) and Franco's state (1939-1975) are other Cliopatria rows.' morocco.json ledger/18 (7 April 1956), /21 (1 April 1958) and /22 (5 January 1969) name francoist-spain, not kingdom-of-spain, as the counterpart. A landless state cannot be suzerain for 25-44 years; the tint would be drawn for a polity not on the map, beside the Republic's and Franco's own claims.
fixes.fix: End both relations at 1931-04 (vassal_end spanish-morocco and vassal_end spanish-sahara, note: passed to the Second Republic with the rest of the state); drop /ledger/63 and /ledger/64 here (they belong in second-spanish-republic/francoist-spain); keep the 1956 and 1975 facts in notes.

fixes.what: The 1640 event is a split of Portugal from Spain, but /ledger/9 merged all of Spain into iberian-union in 1580 and no event gives Spain its land back in 1640; the split belongs to iberian-union's ledger.
fixes.why: Schema: 'merge: this state absorbs or is absorbed into counterpart'; 'split: part of the state becomes a new state named in counterpart'. After /ledger/9 the dossier holds nothing; Habsburg Spain page: 'in 1640, the Portuguese revolted and fought successfully for their independence from the rest of Iberia' (confirmed).
fixes.fix: Replace /ledger/10 by a 1640 split (or gain) with counterpart iberian-union and region {cliopatria: Kingdom of Spain, year: 1640} (Spain re-emerging as the union breaks), and leave Portugal's split to the iberian-union and kingdom-of-portugal dossiers; month 12 (1 December 1640) if a page gives it.

fixes.why: Siege of Luxembourg (1684) page: the siege ran 'from 27 April to 7 June 1684'; 'The surrender of the Spanish garrison was signed in the French headquarters in Merl' on 3 June; the duchy 'was returned to the Habsburgs by the Treaty of Ryswick in 1697'. kingdom-of-france.json ledger/137: 1684-06 gain from kingdom-of-spain (confidence 3).
fixes.fix: Re-date /ledger/19 to 1684, month 6, confidence 2, source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Luxembourg_(1684) (add to sources[]); mark keyframe kingdom-of-spain_1683 adjust with a correction that removes the Duchy of Luxembourg from June 1684; keep the 1691 keyframe note for the remaining Liege-side cells.

fixes.what: The Sahara interior is gained in 1890 (Cliopatria's year, confidence 1, note says the page has no date), but the page cited dates the inland extension to 1886-1887.
fixes.why: Spanish Sahara page: Spain 'signed a treaty with the Emir of Adrar and Saharawi chieftains which ceded to Spain control over vast areas of desert' (1886) and 'an 1887 decree extended Spanish jurisdiction 150 miles inland'. The interior is also written as a direct gain from nobody while the coast is a vassal (spanish-sahara), so the two halves of one colony get different tints.
fixes.fix: Re-date to 1887 (confidence 2), make it the same relation as /ledger/48 (vassal tint under spanish-sahara, or turn /ledger/48 into a gain), and adjust keyframe kingdom-of-spain_1885 to include the interior from 1887.
